extracted.name: Cream of Chicken Soup Substitute
extracted.description: This homemade Cream of Chicken Soup Substitute only takes 10 minutes to make and is the best creamy and flavorful substitute for a 10.75 oz can.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon paste (, or one cube)
instruction_lines: In a small saucepan whisk together milk and cornstarch. Add butter, bouillon, salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder and parsley.
Bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Once boiling, simmer for 30 more seconds to thicken.
Use in recipes to replace one (10.75 oz) can of cream of (anything) soup.
